Interpret 手背偏下一点 as a near-wrist grazing view: the melon occludes most palm, camera sees side/back arcs of curled digits plus near wrist underside edge. A small continuous support patch remains under rind. Do not pronate the hand to manufacture a full back-of-hand view.
